listing.name: Pre-battle Deployment Orders
listing.summary: Pre-battle Deployment Orders is a vanilla-balance friendly QoL mod.
listing.aiSummary: Adds pre-battle deployment order assignment for lead ships, escorts, and flanks.

description:
Pre-battle Deployment Orders is a vanilla-balance friendly QoL mod.

Download Pre-battle Deployment Orders 1.3.1
No dependencies

Press O to open the menu in Fleet or Refit screen, or click the top-left Orders button in Fleet screen.

Screenshots

Features

Assign a lead ship and assign escorts to it. This can be chained
If no specific escorts are assigned, you can assign light/medium/heavy autofill escort
Assign a lead ship or unassigned ship to Flank
Flank ships automatically get a capture order on their flank, or a waypoint at midway near their edge if none is detected
Toggle Flank between seeking a capture order or waypoint-only
Toggle default Search & Destroy order fleetwide to unassigned/lead ships, assuming no autofill escort group exists
Orders get assigned when ships are deployed, including reinforcements. No interference with player orders or changes during battle

Clean, vanilla-friendly UI design
Player is informed of ships gone missing
No AI changes
Preset management

No compatibility issues that I am aware of. Safe to install and remove* mid-save.

* there will be some left over code classes and junk, but save will remain functional

Changelog
1.3.1 - added auto escort functionality, without specific escort ships assigned. Increased Flank preference for capture points toward friendly spawn (bottom) edge. Added toggle between capture-seeking or waypoint-only Flank.
1.2.2 - fixed menu opening while typing names in refit screen
1.2.1 - slightly expanded Flank role's capture point search radius
1.2.0 - added preset management submenu, added unobtrusive Orders button to Fleet screen, changed default keybind to 'O'

!AI DISCLAIMER!
Vibecoded with Kimi K3.1 Pro Max
